text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The 2nd Stage of the Qualifiers— Public 
attention was steadily building up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The venue bustles with many fans, all 
eager to catch a glimpse of the heroic 
figures of the Umamusume they once cheered 
for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ryoka Tsurugi is driven by her resolve to 
provide "the best event management 
possible." Exchanging words of 
encouragement with her—it's time to head 
to the stage of the preliminary 2nd stage!
